headings.title: Creation of commission and member appointments
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Air Conservation Commission within the department of natural resources and specifies member composition and officer selection.

headings.title: Member qualifications and conflict of interest rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires public interest, sectoral representation, and establishes conflict of interest rules and recusal procedures for commissioners.

headings.title: Terms of office, vacancies, and expenses
headings.reviewNote: Establishes four-year staggered terms with no term limit, permits governor vacancy appointments and removal for cause, and requires reimbursement of actual and necessary expenses.

headings.title: Meeting requirements, quorum, and attendance rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least nine regular meetings annually, a four-member quorum, personal exercise of powers, open meetings except under chapter 610, and deems four regular absences per calendar year a resignation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 643.040 establishing the Air Conservation Commission, membership criteria, terms, meetings, and attendance rules.

headings.title: Powers and regulatory authorities of commission
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates eleven commission powers covering rulemaking (including anhydrous ammonia risk management plans under 42 U.S.C. 7412(r)), air quality standards, monitoring, small business compliance criteria, enforcement, and inspections; source notes effective 1-02-23 and cross-references section 640.099.

headings.title: Administrative procedure compliance for commission rules
headings.reviewNote: Conditions the validity of air conservation rules on compliance with administrative rulemaking standards under section 536.024.

headings.title: Statutory duties for air pollution control
headings.reviewNote: Specifies seven primary duties of the commission regarding comprehensive air planning, public education, research, and interstate agreements.

headings.title: Limitation on jurisdiction over workplace interiors
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that commission jurisdiction does not extend to indoor workplace air pollution or occupational safety and health relations.

headings.title: Confidentiality of secret processes and methods
headings.reviewNote: Requires confidential treatment of information relating to secret processes or methods of manufacture or production discovered through communications required under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 643.050 defining commission powers, rulemaking standards, air conservation duties, jurisdictional limits, and trade secrets.

headings.title: Clean Air Act rules and stringency limits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Clean Air Act compliance rulemaking while prohibiting standards stricter than federal law except for approved nonattainment SIPs.

headings.title: Authority to grant exceptions and variances
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the commission to grant variances and exceptions from state air standards based on hardship, impossibility, or environmental impact.

headings.title: Restrictions on regulating residential wood heaters
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits departmental regulation of residential wood burning heaters absent specific legislative authorization and committee approval.

headings.title: Exemption for existing wood burning heaters
headings.reviewNote: Bars applying new rules to existing wood burning furnaces, stoves, fireplaces, or heaters used to heat homes or businesses or existing on August 28, 2014, and bars state employees from enforcing new rules against them.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 643.055 establishing federal stringency limits, variances, and statutory protections for wood burning heaters.

headings.title: Rulemaking notice and public submission procedures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes notice procedures for proposed air rules, allows seven-day post-hearing statements, and requires written notice of commission action.

headings.title: Hearing requirement and written member approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires public hearings and written approval by at least four commission members for adoption of air rules.

headings.title: Differentiation of rules by source and area
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to vary rule provisions based on air contaminant sources, pollution types, and geographic areas.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.070 governing rulemaking procedures, notice, written four-member approvals, and geographic differentiation.

headings.title: Operating permit application procedures and initial fee
headings.reviewNote: Directs rulemaking for operating permits for existing sources and establishes a one hundred dollar application fee.

headings.title: Unified permit applications for construction and operation
headings.reviewNote: Requires unified review for construction and operating permit applications and guarantees operational flexibility under section 643.078.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.073 establishing operating permit submission rules, fees, and unified construction-operating permit reviews.

headings.title: Construction permit requirement for air sources
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits commencing construction of regulated air contaminant sources without obtaining a construction permit.

headings.title: Application review and unified permit processing
headings.reviewNote: Governs construction permit application investigations, permit conditions, denials, and unified reviews under section 643.078.

headings.title: Ambient air quality impact review and denials
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes permit denial if the proposed source will appreciably affect ambient air quality or where standards are exceeded.

headings.title: Monitoring facilities and testing permit conditions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to require testing and installation of air monitoring facilities as a condition of permit issuance.

headings.title: Permit decision timelines and denial notices
headings.reviewNote: Requires director action within thirty days and approval or denial within ninety days for class B sources and one hundred eighty-four days for class A sources, with prompt written notice and denial reasons.

headings.title: Administrative appeals and judicial review procedures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes administrative appeals through the administrative hearing commission and judicial review in the appellate court.

headings.title: Filing fees, hourly review reimbursements, and funds
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a $100 filing fee (exempting private residences), hourly review cost reimbursements up to $50/hour with hardship exemption and ten percent interest after ninety days, and deposits into the nonreverting air pollution permit fee subaccount.

headings.title: Exemption for holders of valid local permits
headings.reviewNote: Exempts sources holding valid local air permits under section 643.140 from state construction permit requirements and review fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 643.075 governing air construction permits, ambient air reviews, deadlines, appeals, fees, and local exemptions.

headings.title: Operating permit requirement for air sources
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to operate a regulated air contaminant source after August 28, 1992, without an operating permit.

headings.title: Single operating permit for contiguous facilities
headings.reviewNote: Allows operators of multiple air sources on contiguous tracts operated as a single enterprise to obtain a single facility permit.

headings.title: Unified review application and statutory deadlines
headings.reviewNote: Governs unified construction and operating permit reviews within one hundred eighty days for class B sources and federal Section 502 timelines for class A sources; source footnote notes "and" appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Issuance of construction permit and permit retention
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of construction permits upon completed review while retaining the operating permit pending operational validation.

headings.title: Validation of operating permit upon compliance
headings.reviewNote: Requires submitting compliance proof within one hundred eighty days of commencing operations to validate the retained operating permit, with mutually agreed waivers permitted; source footnote notes "and" appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Correction of deficiencies and permit validation terms
headings.reviewNote: Regulates procedures for resolving construction permit deficiencies, adding permit conditions, and public hearings on modified emissions.

headings.title: Five-year duration of operating permits
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a standard five-year validity term for operating permits from the date of issuance or validation.

headings.title: Issuance of superseding five-year operating permits
headings.reviewNote: Permits sources undergoing construction or modification to request a new five-year operating permit superseding existing permits.

headings.title: Decision deadlines for operating permit validation
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty-day action on validation requests, one hundred twenty-day class B and federal Section 502 class A operating permit decisions, and permits administrative hearing commission appeals by affected persons.

headings.title: Suspension, revocation, or modification for cause
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to suspend, revoke, or modify an operating permit for cause.

headings.title: Prohibition on approval upon federal objection
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits approval of operating permits if the Environmental Protection Agency enters a timely objection under Title V.

headings.title: Enforcement and incorporation of federal standards
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to enforce federal Clean Air Act standards and incorporate applicable Title III and V requirements into permits.

headings.title: Incorporation of newly adopted state standards
headings.reviewNote: Regulates incorporation of new commission rules into existing permits based on remaining permit duration and Title V permit shields.

headings.title: Operational flexibility for facility modifications
headings.reviewNote: Grants operational flexibility to make qualifying facility changes without formal permit amendments if emissions limits are not exceeded.

headings.title: Timely renewal application and operating shield
headings.reviewNote: Provides that submitting a complete renewal application six months before expiration extends operating permit validity pending decision.

headings.title: Administrative appeals and judicial review procedures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes administrative appeal procedures through the administrative hearing commission and appellate court judicial review.

headings.title: Exemption for valid local operating permits
headings.reviewNote: Deems sources holding valid local operating permits under section 643.140 to have met all state operating permit requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 17 subsections for 643.078 governing air operating permits, unified reviews, validations, duration, EPA objections, flexibility, and appeals.

headings.title: Annual emissions fee schedule and rate limits
headings.reviewNote: Establishes annual emissions fee schedules between twenty-five and forty dollars per ton to fund air program administration.

headings.title: Fee schedule reductions for charcoal producers
headings.reviewNote: Provides phased fee reductions for wood charcoal manufacturing sources on emissions up to four thousand tons through 2000.

headings.title: Expiration of charcoal producer fee reductions
headings.reviewNote: Terminates special charcoal emission fee provisions after 2000 unless explicitly reauthorized by the general assembly.

headings.title: Emission caps, exemptions, and local fee credits
headings.reviewNote: Caps annual fee assessments at four thousand tons per pollutant and twelve thousand tons per facility while exempting carbon oxides.

headings.title: Deposit in dedicated subaccounts and non-reversion
headings.reviewNote: Allocates emission fees among dedicated Title V and non-Title V protection fund subaccounts and exempts balances from reversion.

headings.title: Collection suits for delinquent fees and interest
headings.reviewNote: Permits circuit court collection actions after thirty days' delinquency, requiring section 408.030 interest and reasonable attorney's fees for the department if it prevails, and reasonable attorney's fees for the source if it prevails.

headings.title: Prohibition on permit revocation for unpaid fees
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits suspending or revoking air operating permits solely due to delinquent emission fee payments.

headings.title: Service fees for Phase I generating units
headings.reviewNote: Establishes annual service fees up to twenty-five thousand dollars for Phase I electric generating units through 1999.

headings.title: State agency fee determinations and budget requests
headings.reviewNote: Requires state agencies and universities to budget line-item appropriations for emissions fees and capital air quality projects.

headings.title: Registration and tonnage fees for anhydrous ammonia
headings.reviewNote: Establishes registration and tonnage fees for agricultural facilities storing anhydrous ammonia under federal risk management plans.

headings.title: Comprehensive fee structure review and sunset
headings.reviewNote: Permits department stakeholder fee reviews, two-thirds commission rulemaking approval, and general assembly concurrent-resolution disapproval; source footnote notes fee-revision authority expires August 28, 2030, leaving existing fees in place, and cross-references section 640.099.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 11 subsections for 643.079 covering annual emissions fees, charcoal reductions, caps, subaccounts, anhydrous ammonia fees, and fee reviews.

headings.title: Investigation of alleged air pollution violations
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to investigate alleged air violations at its own expense and governs disclosure of complainant identities.

headings.title: Referral of violations to prosecutors
headings.reviewNote: Requires referral of substantiated air violations to the attorney general or county prosecutor for legal action.

headings.title: Informal conciliation for noncriminal violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to endeavor to resolve noncriminal violations through conference, conciliation, and persuasion.

headings.title: Abatement orders, permit suspensions, and appeals
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the director to issue abatement or permit revocation orders upon failed conciliation and provides for administrative appeals.

headings.title: Hearing appearance rights and cross-examination
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees petitioners the right to appear with counsel, present evidence, and cross-examine witnesses at commission hearings.

headings.title: Issuance of final order and written notice
headings.reviewNote: Governs the entry of final commission orders following hearing record review or default and requires immediate written notice.

headings.title: Written approval requirement by four members
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least four members of the commission to approve any final order or determination in writing.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsections for 643.080 establishing violation investigations, prosecutorial referrals, conciliation, abatement orders, and appeals.

headings.title: Administrative penalty orders and conciliation prerequisites
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative penalties following conciliation efforts, excludes minor violations, and specifies mandatory order recitals.

headings.title: Penalty matrix rules, appeals, and late surcharges
headings.reviewNote: Limits penalties to statutory civil maximums, establishes sixty-day payment rules, appeal stays, and fifteen percent late surcharges.

headings.title: Statute of limitations and restrictions on increases
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits penalty increases resulting from agency delay and imposes a two-year limitation period from discovery of violations.

headings.title: Judicial review of final penalty orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides for judicial review of final administrative penalty orders under the provisions of section 536.100.

headings.title: Election between administrative and civil remedies
headings.reviewNote: Permits the state to elect between assessing administrative penalties or pursuing civil judicial penalties in circuit court.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 643.085 governing administrative air penalties, conciliation prerequisites, penalty matrices, appeals, and limits.

headings.title: Declaration of ambient air emergency conditions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes declaration of air pollution emergencies with gubernatorial approval and orders restricting emissions enforced by law enforcement.

headings.title: Cease and desist orders for imminent dangers
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission or director to issue immediate written cease and desist orders for clear and present air contamination dangers (subject to commission countermand of director orders) and seek priority circuit court injunctive relief.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.090 governing emergency air declarations with gubernatorial consent and cease and desist orders.

headings.title: Hearing testimony under oath and transcripts
headings.reviewNote: Requires hearing testimony to be taken under oath and recorded, with transcripts made available to parties and the public.

headings.title: Issuance of subpoenas and rules of discovery
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes hearing subpoenas under section 536.077 and applies civil rules of discovery to commission proceedings.

headings.title: Presiding officers and written member approvals
headings.reviewNote: Specifies presiding officers for rulemaking and contested hearings and requires four-member written approval after transcript review.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.100 establishing hearing procedures, recorded transcripts, subpoenas, and presiding officer rules.

headings.title: Authority to grant individual variances
headings.reviewNote: Permits individual variances from air standards to prevent uncompensated taking or closure of a lawful business where no health hazard continues, without relieving nuisance liability under other law.

headings.title: Equitable criteria for evaluating variance requests
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to exercise discretion by balancing equities and public impacts when evaluating variance petitions.

headings.title: Duration, conditions, and extensions of variances
headings.reviewNote: Requires variances to specify terms, conditions, and time limits, and authorizes formal extensions by the commission.

headings.title: Variance petition procedures and burden of proof
headings.reviewNote: Establishes variance petition investigation procedures, hearing rights for aggrieved parties, and places the burden of proof on petitioners.

headings.title: Revocation or modification for noncompliance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes revocation or modification of variances for noncompliance following a public hearing with thirty days' written notice.

headings.title: Director review timelines and hearing requests
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a thirty-day action timeline and one hundred twenty-day recommendation deadline on director review of variance petitions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 643.110 governing individual air variances, equitable balancing, petition procedures, revocations, and deadlines.

headings.title: Local air programs and certificates of authority
headings.reviewNote: Disclaims total state preemption and authorizes qualifying municipalities and counties to obtain certificates of authority.

headings.title: Local permit issuance and state oversight
headings.reviewNote: Governs local permit and variance issuances, fifteen-day state notifications, and thirty-day departmental approval reviews.

headings.title: Equivalent effect of approved local permits
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that valid permits or variances issued under local certificates of authority operate as state permits.

headings.title: State enforcement within local program jurisdictions
headings.reviewNote: Confirms state commission authority to enforce state air laws and regulations within certified local jurisdictions.

headings.title: Ordinance powers for charter counties and large cities
headings.reviewNote: Affirms ordinance enactment and enforcement powers for constitutional charter counties and cities over seventy-five thousand population.

headings.title: Air programs in first and second class counties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes first and second class counties to adopt commission standards, appoint control officers, and enforce regulations.

headings.title: Air standards in third and fourth class counties
headings.reviewNote: Allows third and fourth class counties to adopt state air rules enforced through intergovernmental contracts with adjacent certified counties.

headings.title: Intergovernmental agreements to form air regions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes political subdivisions to establish, finance, and operate regional air pollution control programs under chapter 70.

headings.title: Continuation of prior certificates of authority
headings.reviewNote: Maintains the validity of municipal and county certificates of authority issued by the commission prior to August 13, 1972.

headings.title: Suspension or repeal of certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to suspend or revoke local certificates of authority for inconsistent enforcement following a hearing.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 10 subsections for 643.140 governing local air pollution control programs, certificates of authority, county classes, and oversight.

headings.title: Unlawful air pollution emissions in Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Makes it unlawful to cause or permit air pollution by discharging air contaminants in violation of state statutes or rules.

headings.title: Prohibition on out-of-state emissions entering Missouri
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits knowing out-of-state emissions that enter Missouri in excess of applicable local air quality standards.

headings.title: Injunctive relief, civil penalties, and settlements
headings.reviewNote: Permits civil actions for injunctions and/or penalties up to $10,000 per violation per day (barred if section 643.085 administrative penalties were assessed) and regulates written settlement offers.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for disclosure of confidential information
headings.reviewNote: Makes willful disclosure or conspiracy to disclose confidential information by a commission member or employee a class A misdemeanor punishable by a fine up to one thousand dollars.

headings.title: Exemption from liability for force majeure catastrophes
headings.reviewNote: Exempts persons from air violation liability when noncompliance is caused by acts of God, war, strikes, riots, or catastrophes.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 643.151 establishing emission prohibitions, out-of-state sources, civil penalties, confidentiality crimes, and catastrophe defenses.

headings.title: Public contract prohibition for unpermitted entities
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits state agencies and political subdivisions from contracting with persons required to apply for an air permit unless they have applied for or received a permit or been granted a variance.

headings.title: Public contract prohibition for contempt violators
headings.reviewNote: Bars governmental entities from contracting with any person in contempt of a court order enforcing state air conservation laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.161 barring public contracts with unpermitted air pollution sources and court contempt violators.

headings.title: Preservation of existing civil and criminal remedies
headings.reviewNote: Preserves existing common law and statutory civil and criminal remedies against impairment by state air laws.

headings.title: Preclusion of private causes of action
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that state air conservation statutes do not create private rights of action or evidentiary legal presumptions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.170 preserving existing remedies while precluding implied private causes of action.

headings.title: Creation and duties of small business ombudsman
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the small business ombudsman within the governor's office to monitor technical assistance and investigate complaints.

headings.title: Appointment and term of small business ombudsman
headings.reviewNote: Provides for gubernatorial appointment of the ombudsman with senate consent for terms concurrent with the governor.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.175 establishing the small business ombudsman, oversight duties, and gubernatorial appointment terms.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for knowing air standard violations
headings.reviewNote: Imposes criminal fines up to ten thousand dollars per day for knowing violations of air standards, permit conditions, or fees.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for false statements and tampering
headings.reviewNote: Establishes criminal fines up to ten thousand dollars per violation for making false statements or tampering with air monitors.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.191 establishing criminal penalties for knowing violations of air requirements and fraudulent reporting.

headings.title: Emissions questionnaire compliance cost and employment evaluation
headings.reviewNote: Requires sources filing emissions questionnaires to evaluate compliance costs and employment impacts of the federal Clean Air Act.

headings.title: Annual department cost and air quality reports
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to tabulate compliance costs and air quality changes, submit annual reports to the commission and general assembly beginning January 1, 1995 (including section 643.305.5 data), and correlate air quality improvements with avoided health costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.192 requiring employer reporting of federal Clean Air Act costs and departmental air quality reports.

headings.title: Establishment of emissions banking and trading program
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to establish an air emissions banking and trading program to attain National Ambient Air Quality Standards.

headings.title: Program criteria and emissions trading restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies seven mandatory criteria for the emissions trading program, including criteria pollutant limits and surplus reduction rules.

headings.title: Credit verification, certification, and geographic limits
headings.reviewNote: Requires departmental verification before banking credits and restricts credit usage to the same modeling domain or nonattainment area.

headings.title: Mandatory criteria for creditable emission reductions
headings.reviewNote: Requires emission reductions to be permanent, quantifiable, and federally approved to qualify for deposit in the emissions bank.

headings.title: Eligibility timeline for tradeable emission credits
headings.reviewNote: Restricts tradeable emission credits to verified reductions occurring after August 28, 2001, or existing banked credits.

headings.title: Annual bank reduction in nonattainment areas
headings.reviewNote: Mandates an annual three percent reduction of banked criteria pollutant credits in areas designated as nonattainment.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 643.220 establishing the air emissions banking and trading program, criteria, verifications, and nonattainment retirements.

headings.title: Applicability, rulemaking authority, and certification examinations
headings.reviewNote: Applies asbestos standards to NESHAP projects, grants rulemaking authority, and establishes state certification examinations.

headings.title: Mandatory certification for asbestos project disciplines
headings.reviewNote: Requires state certification prior to engaging in asbestos abatement, inspection, design, management planning, or air sampling.

headings.title: Certification requirements and air professional qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Specifies training, examination, and educational credentials required for certification across asbestos disciplines and air monitors.

headings.title: Application fees and examination charges
headings.reviewNote: Assesses a $75 application fee for each certification category except asbestos abatement worker ($25) and a $25 fee per state examination.

headings.title: Annual refresher training and recertification requirements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual refresher courses and examinations for certificate renewal and provides for decertification upon compliance failure.

headings.title: Certificate renewal fee for administrative costs
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a five-dollar fee for annual renewal of asbestos certifications to cover administrative processing expenses.

headings.title: Exemption for internal facility normal operations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts qualifying business facilities conducting internal asbestos maintenance under federal OSHA/EPA standards from state certification.

headings.title: One-time application fee for facility exemption
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a one-time two hundred fifty dollar application fee for facilities seeking in-house asbestos maintenance exemptions.

headings.title: Validity of prior exemptions and reporting
headings.reviewNote: Grandfathers facility exemptions approved prior to August 28, 2012, without additional fees subject to curriculum reporting.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 9 subsections for 643.225 governing asbestos project certifications, credentials, refresher courses, fees, and facility exemptions.

headings.title: Biennial accreditation of asbestos training programs
headings.reviewNote: Requires biennial state accreditation of asbestos training courses and authorizes unannounced state monitoring of training sessions.

headings.title: Accreditation fees and simultaneous application cap
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a one thousand dollar accreditation fee per course category, capped at three thousand dollars for simultaneous submissions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.228 establishing biennial accreditation, monitoring, and fee caps for asbestos training courses.

headings.title: Grounds for denial, suspension, or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates five statutory grounds authorizing the director to deny, suspend, or revoke asbestos certifications or accreditations.

headings.title: Ninety-day limitation on certificate suspensions
headings.reviewNote: Caps certificate or exemption suspensions at ninety days, requiring reinstatement unless revoked by the director or expired.

headings.title: Appeals of credential denials, suspensions, or revocations
headings.reviewNote: Permits appealing denial, suspension, or revocation of certification, accreditation, or exemption to the commission within thirty days with a hearing within sixty days.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.230 governing asbestos certification suspensions, revocations, ninety-day limits, and commission appeals.

headings.title: Annual contractor registration and certified personnel
headings.reviewNote: Requires asbestos abatement contractors to register annually with the department and employ only certified and trained personnel.

headings.title: Workplace safety standards and on-site supervisor
headings.reviewNote: Mandates compliance with EPA and OSHA asbestos regulations and requires a designated competent person on site during abatement.

headings.title: Annual contractor registration fee requirement
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a one thousand dollar registration fee payable to the state prior to issuing contractor registration.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.232 establishing asbestos contractor registration, safety standards, on-site supervision, and fees.

headings.title: Grounds for contractor registration enforcement actions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies statutory grounds for the director to deny, suspend, or revoke asbestos contractor registrations.

headings.title: Contractor registration appeals and hearing timeline
headings.reviewNote: Provides for administrative appeals of contractor registration actions to the commission and hearings within ninety days.

headings.title: Reapplication timeline following registration revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes revoked asbestos contractors to reapply for registration one year following the effective date of revocation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.235 specifying grounds for contractor registration actions, commission appeals, and reapplication rules.

headings.title: Project notification requirements, fees, and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Imposes advance notice, inspection surveys, sixty-day completion notices, and one hundred dollar fees for major asbestos projects.

headings.title: Schedule reporting and advance amendment procedures
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting of actual project dates and mandates twenty-four hours' advance telephone notice for schedule modifications.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.237 governing major asbestos abatement and demolition project notifications, fees, and schedule amendments.

headings.title: Efforts to minimize friable asbestos spread
headings.reviewNote: Requires persons before commencing an asbestos abatement project to make all reasonable efforts to minimize the spread of friable asbestos-containing materials to uncontaminated areas.

headings.title: Regulation of materials rendered friable
headings.reviewNote: Subjects all asbestos-containing materials rendered friable during abatement or demolition to federal and state standards.

headings.title: Analytical standards for asbestos air samples
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that analysis of asbestos air samples comply with federal OSHA or EPA analytical protocols.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.240 establishing friable asbestos containment rules, material standards, and air sampling protocols.

headings.title: Inspection authority for regulated asbestos projects
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes departmental inspections of major asbestos abatement and regulated demolition projects.

headings.title: On-site inspection fees and postponement assessments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes on-site inspection fees up to $100 capped at three inspections during an active project, and provides that failing to notify the department of postponement may result in an inspection fee.

headings.title: Exemption from state fees in local jurisdictions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts asbestos projects in certified local air jurisdictions from state inspection fees if local fees are assessed.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.242 establishing asbestos project inspection powers, fee limits, and local agency exemptions.

headings.title: Creation of air pollution asbestos fee subaccount
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the asbestos fee subaccount in the state treasury, restricts expenditures to program administration, and bars reversion.

headings.title: Creation of anhydrous ammonia subaccount and uses
headings.reviewNote: Creates the dedicated anhydrous ammonia risk management subaccount for program administration and exempts balances from reversion.

headings.title: Investment of moneys and interest credits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the state treasurer to deposit fund moneys and credits earned interest to the asbestos fee subaccount.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.245 establishing dedicated asbestos and anhydrous ammonia fee subaccounts and non-reversion status.

headings.title: Inspection entry authority and refusal remedies
headings.reviewNote: Permits authorized department representatives to enter public or private property at reasonable times for asbestos regulation, making refusal grounds for registration revocation or injunctive relief.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for knowing asbestos violations
headings.reviewNote: Punishes knowing violations by $2,500 to $25,000 per day and/or up to one year's imprisonment, increasing to up to $50,000 per day and/or two years for second and successive convictions.

headings.title: Civil monetary penalties for asbestos violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes civil penalties up to ten thousand dollars per day designed to serve as an economic deterrent.

headings.title: Injunctive relief actions by the commission
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the commission to maintain judicial actions in the name of the state for injunctive relief against asbestos violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 643.250 establishing asbestos inspection entry, criminal penalties, civil fines, and injunctive remedies.

headings.title: Public bidding compliance for asbestos projects
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits public agencies and political subdivisions from accepting asbestos project bids that fail to comply with state law.

headings.title: Public employee compliance on asbestos projects
headings.reviewNote: Requires governmental agencies to comply with state asbestos standards when performing abatement using their own employees.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.255 mandating statutory compliance for public agency asbestos contracts and in-house employee work.

headings.title: Asbestos assessment reports by schools and entities
headings.reviewNote: Mandates reporting of friable asbestos building assessments by schools and political subdivisions to the health department.

headings.title: Report contents, reevaluations, and technical assistance
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required assessment details, mandates periodic reevaluations, and directs health department technical assistance.

headings.title: Annual list of school districts with asbestos
headings.reviewNote: Requires the health department to provide an annual list of public school districts with friable asbestos to DESE.

headings.title: Asbestos assessments in state-owned buildings
headings.reviewNote: Directs the health department and office of administration to assess asbestos in state-owned and leased facilities.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 643.263 governing asbestos building assessments in schools, political subdivisions, and state facilities.

headings.title: Decentralized on-board diagnostic inspection program
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a decentralized on-board diagnostic emissions inspection program for 1996 and newer vehicles starting in 2007.

headings.title: Station authorization and highway patrol coordination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes qualified safety inspection stations and other entities to apply for certificates to perform emissions testing.

headings.title: Vehicle repairs and station service election
headings.reviewNote: Allows certified inspection stations to perform emissions repairs and elect between test-only or test-and-repair operations.

headings.title: Pre-implementation certification and legislative progress report
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes early station certifications and requires a progress report to the governor and general assembly prior to 2007.

headings.title: Remote sensing and clean screen program
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remote sensing emissions monitoring and clean screen programs allowing qualifying low-emitting vehicles to bypass testing.

headings.title: Gas cap pressure and visual testing
headings.reviewNote: Permits incorporating gas cap pressure tests and visual emissions checks into regular motor vehicle safety inspections.

headings.title: Definition of decentralized emissions inspection program
headings.reviewNote: Defines decentralized emissions inspection program as testing conducted by certified inspectors at official stations.

headings.title: Compliance with federal environmental protection standards
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that the decentralized vehicle emissions inspection program satisfy all applicable federal EPA regulatory standards.

headings.title: Exemption from statutory sunset review mandates
headings.reviewNote: Exempts the decentralized motor vehicle emissions inspection program from statutory sunset review under sections 23.250 to 23.298.

headings.title: Interagency agreement between department and highway patrol
headings.reviewNote: Requires an interagency agreement between the department and highway patrol by July 1, 2007, for program administration.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and administrative procedure compliance
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission implementing rules by July 1, 2007, subject to chapter 536, section 536.028 if applicable, and nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2006.

headings.title: Program promotion and geographic station accessibility
headings.reviewNote: Requires promoting station participation prior to September 1, 2007, monitoring participation, and attempting through promotional efforts to keep no more than twenty percent of residents farther than five miles from a station.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 12 subsections for 643.303 establishing decentralized OBD emissions testing, station criteria, clean screening, and agreements.

headings.title: Adoption of state implementation plan for nonattainment
headings.reviewNote: Directs adoption of a state implementation plan to achieve National Ambient Air Quality Standards in designated nonattainment areas.

headings.title: Establishment of required emission reduction amounts
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to establish required emissions reduction targets to attain federal air quality standards.

headings.title: Establishment of metropolitan air quality baseline
headings.reviewNote: Requires establishing an air quality baseline for nonattainment areas within a metropolitan statistical area of at least one million inhabitants.

headings.title: Cost-benefit evaluation of emission reduction measures
headings.reviewNote: Requires cost-benefit analysis of alternative stationary, mobile, and transportation control measures with planning agencies.

headings.title: Annual evaluation and legislative program recommendations
headings.reviewNote: Directs annual evaluations of vehicle inspection costs, repair expenditures, and recommendations on program continuation.

headings.title: Public information and education program
headings.reviewNote: Requires a public education program regarding the costs and benefits of air quality attainment measures prior to plan adoption.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 643.305 governing nonattainment state implementation plans, reduction targets, baselines, and program reporting.

headings.title: Authority to establish decentralized inspection program
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commission by rule to establish a uniform decentralized vehicle emissions inspection program in designated nonattainment areas and requires incorporating applicable federal EPA credits.

headings.title: Operator selection, contracting, and license terms
headings.reviewNote: Governs competitive bidding and contracting for inspection facility operators, up to seven-year terms, and revocations for cause.

headings.title: Minority and Missouri business participation requirements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates cooperation with the minority business advocacy commission to ensure minority and Missouri business participation.

headings.title: Dealer association and fleet inspection facilities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes motor vehicle dealer organizations and fleet operators to establish specialized inspection facilities under state oversight.

headings.title: Conventional gasoline storage in nonattainment areas
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that if the governor applies to the EPA for federal reformulated gasoline in nonattainment areas, storing conventional gasoline there for outside customers is not prevented.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 643.310 governing decentralized program rules, contractor selection, minority business quotas, and fuel storage.

headings.title: Mandatory vehicle emissions inspection and registration
headings.reviewNote: Requires biennial emissions inspections on even- or odd-numbered model year schedules prior to vehicle registration or transfer.

headings.title: Statutory vehicle exemptions from emissions testing
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates thirteen statutory categories of motor vehicles exempt from mandatory vehicle emissions inspections.

headings.title: Inspection reciprocity with other states
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the commission to establish inspection reciprocity agreements with states maintaining equivalent emissions standards.

headings.title: Motor vehicle dealer sales options and disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Establishes dealer options to sell with prior inspection (written disclosure, 120-day validity) or without (conspicuous disclosure, ten-day/1,000-mile return right, section 407.020 unlawful practice), exempting section 307.380.2 sales; source footnote notes section 643.360 was repealed in 2007.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 643.315 establishing biennial emissions inspection mandates, statutory vehicle exemptions, reciprocity, and dealer sales rules.

headings.title: Inspection station equipment, standards, and insurance
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes equipment, inspector qualification standards, and mandatory liability insurance for official inspection stations.

headings.title: Application for authorization, fees, and renewals
headings.reviewNote: Governs station authorization applications, sets an annual fee up to one hundred dollars, and directs fund deposits.

headings.title: Unannounced station inspections and license revocations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes unannounced covert station audits, establishes license suspension procedures, and requires written show-cause hearings.

headings.title: Reporting requirements for official inspection stations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to require official emissions inspection stations to submit operational reports on prescribed forms.

headings.title: Alternative administrative penalties and remedial retraining
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commission to impose alternative enforcement remedies, including mandatory inspector retraining, in lieu of suspension.

headings.title: Official station signage and customer posters
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to supply durable official station signs and mandatory consumer posters regarding independent repair choices.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 643.320 governing inspection station authorizations, equipment, audits, suspensions, reporting, and signs.

headings.title: Establishment of inspection certificates, stickers, and legend
headings.reviewNote: Directs rulemaking for certificates and inspection stickers displaying the mandatory federal congressional mandate legend.

headings.title: Issuance of certificates and stickers upon approval
headings.reviewNote: Requires emissions inspection stations to issue official certificates and display stickers to owners of passing vehicles.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.325 establishing emissions inspection certificates, windshield stickers, and the federal legend.

headings.title: Reinspection after vehicle emissions repairs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes vehicle owners to have failing vehicles reinspected after completing necessary emissions repairs or adjustments.

headings.title: Free reinspection within twenty business days
headings.reviewNote: Provides one free reinspection within twenty business days if performed at the original inspection station.

headings.title: Written failure diagnosis and repair cost estimate
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that inspectors provide written failure reports identifying defective components and estimated repair expenses.

headings.title: Covert audits of repair facilities and referrals
headings.reviewNote: Directs covert audits of vehicle repair shops and referral of suspected merchandising fraud violations to the attorney general.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 643.330 governing reinspections, free 20-day retests, failure diagnosis reports, and repair facility audits.

headings.title: Maximum monetary waiver limit for repairs
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to establish a maximum emissions repair waiver threshold not to exceed four hundred fifty dollars.

headings.title: Verification procedures and forms for repair waivers
headings.reviewNote: Requires rulemaking to establish verification forms and procedures confirming repairs prior to granting emissions waivers.

headings.title: Affidavit requirements and independent repair verification
headings.reviewNote: Requires repair affidavits with itemized statements and prohibits repair facilities from conducting their own waiver inspections.

headings.title: Criteria for waiver and technician qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Conditions emissions waivers on a complete signed affidavit, meeting the cost threshold, and repairs by a recognized repair technician holding ASE A6, A8, and L1 certifications; source footnote notes "possess" in original rolls for "possesses".

headings.title: Exclusion of manufacturer warranty repair costs
headings.reviewNote: Excludes costs covered under manufacturer emissions warranties from the waiver amount absent written warranty denials.

headings.title: Exclusion of tampering repair expenditures
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits expenditures required to reverse emissions system tampering from counting toward the statutory waiver threshold.

headings.title: Self-repair waiver standards and component receipts
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a four hundred dollar parts-only waiver standard for self-repairs, excluding owner labor and requiring receipts.

headings.title: Reduced waiver threshold for public assistance recipients
headings.reviewNote: Permits establishing a lower waiver amount by rule for owners providing government-issued proof thirty calendar days before inspection of sole financial dependence on disability or public assistance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 8 subsections for 643.335 establishing emissions repair waivers, monetary caps, technician credentials, self-repairs, and hardship tiers.

headings.title: Joint agency program oversight and rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Requires joint department and highway patrol oversight of emissions inspections and recognized repair technician services, and permits promulgating joint implementing rules.

headings.title: Annual legislative report on program oversight
headings.reviewNote: Requires joint annual reports to the general assembly beginning October 1, 2008, detailing oversight measures, compliance and fraud data, and improvement recommendations.

headings.title: Administrative procedure compliance for joint rules
headings.reviewNote: Subjects joint rules to chapter 536, section 536.028 if applicable, and nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2006.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.337 providing for joint DNR and Highway Patrol oversight, annual reports, and administrative rules.

headings.title: Direct route travel for emissions inspections
headings.reviewNote: Permits unregistered vehicle operation along the most direct route to an inspection station solely for obtaining emissions tests.

headings.title: Vehicle operation between station and repair facility
headings.reviewNote: Allows operating unregistered vehicles directly between an inspection station and repair facility for required adjustments.

headings.title: Grace period to reset readiness monitors
headings.reviewNote: Permits operating an unregistered vehicle for thirty days past registration expiration to reset OBD readiness monitors while carrying failing OBD test results, without waiving section 301.050 late registration penalties.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 643.340 allowing limited vehicle operation without current registration for inspections, repairs, and monitor resets.

headings.title: Maximum fee for vehicle emissions inspection
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes inspection stations to charge an emissions inspection fee not exceeding twenty-four dollars.

headings.title: Conspicuous posting of inspection fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires inspection stations to display the emissions inspection fee conspicuously on their premises.

headings.title: Rulemaking for state fee remittance schedule
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission by rule to establish the portion of the inspection fee remitted to the director of revenue and the remittance timeframe.

headings.title: Missouri air emission reduction fund and non-reversion
headings.reviewNote: Requires stations to remit the state portion to the state treasurer for deposit in the nonreverting Missouri Air Emission Reduction Fund, with earned interest accruing to the fund.

headings.title: Supplemental appropriations for program costs
headings.reviewNote: Permits supplementing capital or operating costs, upon appropriation, from general revenue, the state highway department fund, federal funds, or other available funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 643.350 establishing inspection fees, conspicuous postings, fund deposits, and supplemental appropriations.

headings.title: Penalties for misrepresentation of official status
headings.reviewNote: Establishes class C and class B misdemeanor penalties for falsely claiming official inspection station, inspector, or technician status.

headings.title: Penalties for counterfeit certificates or stickers
headings.reviewNote: Imposes misdemeanor penalties for manufacturing, conveying, or possessing counterfeit or illegally obtained emissions certificates or stickers.

headings.title: Penalty for displaying counterfeit inspection sticker
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly displaying a counterfeit or illegal emissions sticker on any motor vehicle as an infraction.

headings.title: Penalties for registration with counterfeit certificate
headings.reviewNote: Establishes graduated penalties for using counterfeit or illegal emissions inspection certificates to obtain vehicle registration.

headings.title: Penalties for operating vehicle without valid sticker
headings.reviewNote: Imposes graduated penalties for operating a required motor vehicle without displaying a valid emissions inspection sticker.

headings.title: Infraction penalty for general program violations
headings.reviewNote: Designates any general violation of vehicle emissions statutes or administrative rules as an infraction.

headings.title: Document seizure and procedural violation fines
headings.reviewNote: Permits the highway patrol superintendent to seize suspected counterfeit or illegally obtained documents and subjects procedural violations to a fine of at least five times the section 643.350 fee or $100 if intentional or grossly negligent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsections for 643.355 establishing criminal and infraction penalties for fraud, counterfeit stickers, uninspected operation, and document seizures.

headings.title: Prohibition on food packaging using chlorofluorocarbons
headings.reviewNote: Bans the sale or distribution of food and beverage products packaged in polystyrene foam manufactured with fully halogenated CFCs.

headings.title: Distributor certification of compliance to department
headings.reviewNote: Requires distributors of extruded polystyrene foam products to certify to the department that their products comply with state bans.

headings.title: Prohibition on extruded polystyrene foam products
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits, beginning January 1, 1992, selling, offering, or distributing thermoformed or extruded polystyrene foam packaging, sheets, or board manufactured using EPA-designated ozone-depleting fully halogenated CFCs.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor penalty and daily offenses
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of CFC packaging prohibitions as class A misdemeanors and treats each day of violation as a separate offense.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 643.400 establishing prohibitions on chlorofluorocarbon foam packaging, certifications, and class A misdemeanors.

headings.title: Appointment and qualifications of interstate commissioners
headings.reviewNote: Directs gubernatorial appointment of five commissioners to the Kansas-Missouri air quality commission and sets residency criteria.

headings.title: Terms of office and vacancy appointments
headings.reviewNote: Establishes four-year staggered terms for interstate compact commissioners and governs annual appointments and vacancy fillings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.610 establishing the appointment, qualifications, and terms of Kansas-Missouri air quality commissioners.

headings.title: Unit-by-unit analysis for carbon dioxide standards
headings.reviewNote: Mandates unit-by-unit evaluations of individual electric generation plants when establishing carbon dioxide emission standards under section 111(d).

headings.title: Consideration of remaining useful facility life
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to consider the remaining useful life of existing affected sources when establishing carbon standards.

headings.title: Evaluation of economic impacts and commercial feasibility
headings.reviewNote: Requires evaluation of overall economic impacts and commercial feasibility when developing carbon dioxide performance standards.

headings.title: Authority to adopt less stringent emission standards
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commission on a unit-by-unit basis to develop less stringent (but not more stringent) standards or longer compliance schedules based on unreasonable cost, physical impossibility, or source-specific economic and rate impacts.

headings.title: Legal authority to implement state plan
headings.reviewNote: Affirms commission legal authority to implement and enforce state implementation plans developed under federal carbon rules.

headings.title: Severability of carbon dioxide standard provisions
headings.reviewNote: Declares the provisions of this section severable so invalidity of any provision or application does not affect other provisions or applications that can be given effect.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsections for 643.640 governing unit-by-unit carbon performance standards, remaining useful life, and less stringent alternatives.

headings.title: Sulfur dioxide monitoring or modeling network
headings.reviewNote: Requires coal-fired electric generating sources in nonattainment areas designated as of April 1, 2015, to develop a twelve-quarter sulfur dioxide monitoring or modeling network with department location approval in one-hour nonattainment areas.

headings.title: Consultation and designations in undesignated areas
headings.reviewNote: Directs departmental consultation with sources on monitor locations and aligns state designation filings with federal deadlines.

headings.title: Consideration of monitored data and voluntary agreements
headings.reviewNote: Requires considering subsection 1 monitoring data before proposing sulfur dioxide limits, while permitting the department to propose voluntarily agreed limits or adjustments supported by at least two quarters of monitored data.

headings.title: Voluntary agreements to reduce permitted emissions
headings.reviewNote: Affirms departmental authority to execute voluntary agreements with generating sources to reduce emissions below permitted levels.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 643.650 governing sulfur dioxide monitoring networks around coal plants, data reviews, and voluntary agreements.

headings.title: Definitions for cotton gin regulatory exemption
headings.reviewNote: Defines air dispersion modeling, cotton gin, and department for purposes of air permitting regulations.

headings.title: Exemption from air dispersion modeling requirements
headings.reviewNote: Exempts non-class A cotton gin operations from submitting air dispersion modeling when applying for air construction permits.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 643.675 defining terms and exempting non-class A cotton gins from air dispersion modeling submittals.
